user.title: Connect to your Vitrea V-Box
user.description: Leave the host empty to find the V-Box on your network automatically. Mobile credentials are optional: without them devices are named "Node N key K"; with them you also get names, rooms and scenes (use an account slot, vitrea1-vitrea8, that no phone is using).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter your V-Box password
reauth_confirm.description: The V-Box rejected the saved password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the V-Box on its control port (11502). Check the IP address and that the V-Box is on the same network.
error.cannot_connect_mobile: The V-Box was found, but the mobile login failed to connect. Check that no other device is logged in with this account, or clear the mobile fields.
error.invalid_auth: The V-Box rejected the mobile user or password.
error.no_vbox_found: No V-Box found on your network. Enter its IP address.

data_description.mobile_user: Add mobile credentials to get names, rooms and scenes.
data_description.mobile_password: Leave empty for generic "Node N key K" names.
data_description.disable_metadata_cache: Skip the device-list cache. Turn on, click Reload, then turn off again to force a one-off rescan.
data_description.excluded_keys: Comma-separated node:key pairs (0-indexed) to skip, e.g. 12:3,40:0
data_description.use_rooms_as_areas: Put each node's device in the area named after its V-Box room (existing areas of the same name are reused, others are created). Never overrides an area you set yourself.

error.invalid_auth: The V-Box rejected the mobile user or password.
error.cannot_connect_mobile: The V-Box was found, but the mobile login failed to connect. Check that no other device is logged in with this account, or clear the mobile fields.
